modelPlan.focus: Argue that improving public transport networks is more effective than building more roads for vehicle ownership.
outline: body1: Advantages of expanding public transport networks (e.g., reducing traffic congestion, environmental benefits, inclusivity)
body2: Limitations of building more roads (e.g., urban sprawl, increased pollution, inequity)
keyArguments: Expanding public transport helps reduce traffic congestion and promotes sustainable urban planning.
Building more roads for vehicles exacerbates urban sprawl and increases negative externalities of private transport.
